subject: general
question: Who among the following persons is NOT a co-author of the book 'Till We Win: India's Fight Against the Covid-19 Pandemic'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Soumya Swaminathan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Till we win: India's fight against the Covid-19 pandemic' is a formidable book by Dr. Chandrakant Lahariya, Dr. Gagandeep Kang, and Dr. Randeep Guleria – three medical experts at the forefront of India’s fight against Covid-19.**
 
• The **book was about:**
 
 
• the misinformation that surrounded the pandemic.
 
• the need to provide key information to citizens about how the pandemic emerged and grew – what was done, what continues to be done, and what the future may hold for India.
 
 
 
• It **also aimed to capitalize on the increased interest in the health system among the policy audience,** as the country readies for the "new normal".

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Soumya Swaminathan**

 
 
• ​Soumya Swaminathan is an **Indian paediatrician and clinical scientist **known for her **research on tuberculosis and HIV.**
 
• Since March 2019, Swaminathan has served as the Chief Scientist at the World Health Organization.**​**
 
 
 
• **Dr. Randeep Guleria**
 
 
• ​Randeep Guleria is an **Indian pulmonologist a**nd the current director of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi.
 
• He is credited with the establishment of India's first center for pulmonary medicines and sleep disorders at AIIMS.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Gagandeep Kang**
 
 
• ​Gagandeep Kang is an **Indian Microbiologist and virologist.**
 
• She** **is the Professor in the Department of Gastrointestinal Sciences at the Christian Medical College, Vellore, India.
 
• She is a leading researcher with a major research focus on viral infections in children and the testing of rotaviral vaccines.
 
 
 
• **Dr Chandrakant Lahariya**
 
 
• ​Chandrakant Lahariya is an **Indian medical doctor, epidemiologist, vaccinologist, public health, policy expert, and writer.**
 
• His work centres around strengthening health systems, and public policy interventions to address health inequities and develop innovative models for health service delivery.
 
 

81:T1beb
